post.description: Persist the request key until success. On 201 or 409 reload /v1/me and continue with its current company; receipt name/version is historical, never an If-Match value. 403 means prior membership requires existing-company access or invitation.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Reuse this key for network retries of one upload attempt. After a rejected attempt, keep client_capture_id and use a new Idempotency-Key for prepare.
